source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Limit routine walking inside the home so the older adult has fewer opportunities to experience a fall.","B":"Remove tripping hazards, improve lighting, and install bathroom grab bars or other appropriate home-safety supports.","C":"Keep familiar throw rugs in walking paths while adding brighter lighting to improve visual contrast.","D":"Use loose backless slippers indoors because they are easier to remove if balance is lost."}}
source_row.rationale: CDC fall-prevention guidance recommends removing trip hazards, improving home lighting, and installing grab bars near the toilet and tub or shower. These measures directly reduce common environmental fall hazards.
source_row.source_detail: CDC home-safety recommendations include removing trip hazards, adding grab bars, and improving lighting.
